# libjpeg-turbo 3.2.0 source archive

`libjpeg-turbo-3.2.0.tar.gz` is an unmodified `git archive` of the upstream
`3.2.0` tag at commit `c85e6b905bf237038faa936dab160ebfc5da0344`.

SHA-256: `f1b91499f5d6eef3c49f63f19554cef2ea91949adcc0efb6ce525032e0bbffa9`

Upstream: <https://github.com/libjpeg-turbo/libjpeg-turbo>

The archive contains the upstream `LICENSE.md` and complete corresponding
source. It is extracted into the native build directory at configure time and
is used only by `libindexed-jpeg-simd.so`.
